remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully updated all-brick ranch, ideally located near the Cheektowaga/West Seneca border. This move-in-ready home offers 3 spacious bedrooms, 1 full bath and an attached 2-car garage, along with a long list of recent improvements. Inside, you'll find brand-new vinyl flooring throughout (2026), fresh whole-house paint (2026), updated ceiling fans and separate living and dining areas. Major mechanical updates include a furnace replaced in 2021 and brand-new hot water tank in 2026, while the windows were updated in 2011. The attached 2-car garage has also been fully renovated. Downstairs, the spacious semi-finished basement offers tremendous flexibility for recreation, entertaining, hobbies and storage, complete with a bar area, washer and dryer and two newly updated sump pumps. Outside, enjoy a large private backyard with a deck, mature trees, privacy fencing and a spacious wooden storage shed for lawn equipment, tools and outdoor gear. The yard is already set up for a swimming pool, providing even more possibilities for summertime enjoyment. With extensive updates, a versatile basement, attached 2-car garage and plenty of indoor and outdoor space, this well-maintained ranch is ready for its next owner to move right in and enjoy!
